candidates.title: How To: KETTLEBELL HALO
candidates.description:
► 100 Swings A Day Challenge: https://zackhenderson.com/100-swings-a-day

The kettlebell halo is a simple beginner-friendly exercise that improves shoulder mobility and strength. 

Kettlebell halo alternatives and progressions include breaking the circle up into 2 directions:
Front to back (pull-over)
Side to side (rainbow)

Kettlebell halo variations include:
The half-kneeling halo to open the hip flexors
The halo at the bottom of a squat to challenge mobility and posture.

The halo is useful to include in any warm-up for a few sets of 5 reps.
